budget.expected_hours: readiness ~2.5-3 h (28 evaluations); generation ~1.5 h; evaluation ~8-10 h (about 90 unique diffs, workers=1)
budget.expected_usd: about 1.1 (112 base episodes + expected <= 20 static repairs)

decision_rule.primary: GOLD RESOLVED_ROBUST episodes per variant (3 replicates x member tasks)
decision_rule.task_direction: #tasks(variant > G0) >= #tasks(G0 > variant) on per-task robust counts
tie_breakers: lower mean provider tokens per GOLD episode
simpler variant in order G0 < G1 < G2 < G3

tokens.M14R_FLOOR_MET: winner reaches the floor -> human decision, then a separately frozen M15 design amendment
tokens.M14R_FLOOR_NOT_MET: no variant reaches the floor -> human decision on WP2 reshape
tokens.M14R_PLACEBO_LEAK_REVIEW: any variant PLACEBO robust resolved > 1 -> human decision

endpoints.co_reported: RESOLVED_STRICT = frozen Smoke v2.2 D50-D52 (any non-pass in any rep fails preservation)
endpoints.primary_development: RESOLVED_ROBUST: F2P = every behavioral F2P node passed in all 3 reps; a P2P-S/P2P-U200 node counts as broken only if non-passing in >= 2 of 3 reps; preservation PASS/UNDEFINED
endpoints.rationale: Pilot-A shows unchanged parent trees (empty diffs) failing strict preservation through single-repetition failures (b14def73518c P2P-S, d3847fa5f518 P2P-U), i.e. measured false regressions; the 2-of-3 rule was chosen a priori, not tuned
endpoints.reporting_fix: flaky_under_patch is replaced in reporting by f2p_pass3 / intermittent / deterministic / missing counts; gates unaffected

evaluator.empty_diff_identity: scored from the task's readiness negative control (one parent evaluation per task)
evaluator.engine: frozen materialize + evaluate (3 reps, fresh DB, workers=1) with M14A-E1 PATCH_STARTUP_FAILURE semantics

context.C0: frozen Smoke v2.2 / Pilot-A prompt (G0 generator)
context.C2: C0 + IMPORT_OUTLINE_V1 read-only context appended to the user prompt and one system-prompt sentence; editable set unchanged

factors.pairing: G1 is derived from the SAME G0 base generation (and G3 from G2): the static factor is a paired post-processing step, so G0-G1 and G2-G3 differ only where a static repair was triggered; C0 and C2 are independent generations

static.on: STATIC_UNDEFINED_V1: after an APPLIED candidate, pyflakes UndefinedName/UndefinedLocal/UndefinedExport findings NEW relative to the parent version of the same file trigger exactly one extra repair whose message contains only those findings; an invalid repair output keeps the APPLIED base candidate (never lowers APPLIED)

audits_at_freeze: every outline line is a verbatim line of its parent module
no changed-test path and no F2P/P2P node id in the context (evaluator-side scan; blocking)
import_outline_v1.content: verbatim source lines only: class headers + class-level assignment lines + method signature lines (with decorators), function signature lines, module-level assignment first lines; whole public module when a module is imported, else only the imported names
import_outline_v1.source: parent snapshot only (host git show of the task parent)
import_outline_v1.targets: one hop: modules imported by the editable .py files (absolute and relative imports), repository files only; excluded: editable files, test paths, migrations, non-.py

leakage_barriers: no F2P/P2P ids, changed-test paths, target diff or target-only lines in any prompt
editable scope unchanged and hard (out-of-scope FILE blocks rejected)
no Pilot-A or Pilot-B task generated or evaluated
evaluator sets are read only by evaluator-side code
m15_relation: M14R never starts M15. If M14R_FLOOR_MET, M15 needs a separately frozen amendment: generator = frozen winner code+hashes; Pilot-B keeps its GOLD_HARD reference arm with a pre-declared floor gate (GOLD RESOLVED_ROBUST >= 4/24 with 12 tasks x 2 reps, scaled by gates_for); if that gate fails the selector comparison is declared uninformative. Pilot-A is not reused as confirmatory calibration.
pilot_a_use: Pilot-A is used only for (i) the existence of the floor, (ii) the instrument observation that motivates the robust preservation rule, (iii) the generic undefined-name failure class (also seen on ENG 823b). No threshold or parameter was tuned on Pilot-A outcomes. Pilot-A is never re-run or re-scored confirmatorily.

population.readiness: zero-API per task: (1) negative control = empty diff: F2P strict FAIL and robust preservation PASS/UNDEFINED; (2) positive control = gold diff restricted to the frozen GOLD_HARD editable set (what a perfect generator could produce): robust RESOLVED. Only READY tasks are members.
population.rule: all 14 ENG tasks with a frozen ENG v3 evaluator set containing >= 1 behavioral F2P node (the Smoke tasks); 22ec4dab0154 and 9258154b8a0b have no F2P node and are excluded by rule

question: On DEV_TRAIN_ENG only, does a small deployment-realistic generator/interface change (static undefined-name repair and/or read-only import outlines) raise the GOLD_HARD floor without weakening hard editable scopes or using hidden-test/target information?
separation: M14R (WP2 repair generator) and AG16/Agent-v2 (WP1 selector agent) share no code path or evidence root; M15 keeps the frozen protocol-v3 Agent (D5).
status: DESIGN_FROZEN_BEFORE_ANY_M14R_OUTPUT (zero M14R API calls made at freeze)

stop_semantics.evaluation infrastructure: resumable EVAL_ERROR with E1 diagnostics saved
